itens.titulo: Leilões de energia existente movimentam R$ 14,25 bilhões; Axia e BTG lideram vendas
itens.descricao: Leilões de energia existente movimentam R$ 14,25 bilhões; Axia e BTG lideram vendas eixos
trechos: Os certames movimentaram R$ 14,25 bilhões e proporcionaram uma economia estimada em R$ 166,4 milhões para os consumidores.
Ao todo, foram atendidas 62 propostas, apresentadas por 47 empresas vendedoras.
Os contratos têm duração de dois anos, com início de suprimento em janeiro de 2027, 2028 e 2029, conforme a modalidade.
A Axia Energia e o BTG Pactual lideraram as vendas no A-1, principal leilão do dia.
As quatro empresas da Axia que participaram do certame — Axia Nordeste, Axia Norte, Axia Sudeste e Axia Sul — somaram 540 MW médios contratados.
Já o BTG Pactual Energia e a BTG Pactual Sertrading totalizaram 439,5 MW médios.

Resultados por modalidade Leilão A-1 O leilão A-1, com fornecimento entre janeiro de 2027 e dezembro de 2028, concentrou a maior parte das negociações, com 2.485 MW médios contratados e R$ 12,48 bilhões em contratos.
Foram atendidas 55 propostas, de 46 empresas vendedoras.

itens.descricao: Nvidia turmoil reshuffles the AI trade. Winners, losers and what investors should watch CNBC
trechos: 17, and is expected to provide updates under interim CEO Colette Kress.
AMD and Broadcom are both up around 17% over the past week, even after a pullback on Friday.
"The biggest thing that Nvidia now has to try to reestablish is trust.
Once you lose the customer's trust, it is going to benefit competitors," said Jay Woods, chief market strategist at Freedom Capital Markets.
"Given the cloud over Nvidia, this is the time for them to capitalize on the trust factor," he added.

"If Nvidia stumbles as a result of internal chaos, we see AMD as the clearest likely beneficiary," Wedbush analyst Matthew Bryson said in a Thursday note, citing a massive need for AI GPUs beyond Nvidia.
He reiterated a buy on the stock and $600 target.

William Blair analyst Sebastien Naji also recommends AMD, saying the company has made "significant progress" in its Helios racks and secured large commitments for chips from OpenAI, Meta Platforms and Anthropic.

itens.titulo: Twenty One Capital Made $1 Billion in Bitcoin Profit. 60% is Already Gone
itens.descricao: Twenty One Capital Made $1 Billion in Bitcoin Profit. 60% is Already Gone Yahoo Finance
trechos: Twenty One Capital reported a $1.087 billion third-quarter profit on Friday.
The money came from Bitcoin (BTC) rising in value, and about 60% of it has already disappeared.
The Texas firm's coins are now worth about $700 million less than it paid.
Where Did Twenty One Capital's $1 Billion Profit Come From?
At the end of September, each Bitcoin was worth about $83,700, the company's quarterly filing shows.
That price lifted its 43,514 coins by $1.093 billion.
It posted a $4.8 million operating loss for the quarter.
"But gains from an asset we own are not the same as earnings from businesses we operate," Rapha Zagury, CEO of Twenty One Capital, in his shareholder letter.

itens.titulo: AMD or Intel: 1 Chip Stock Is the Clear Winner
itens.descricao: AMD or Intel: 1 Chip Stock Is the Clear Winner Yahoo Finance
trechos: AMD's shares are up 158% this year, while Intel's have gained 69%, as of writing.
Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005.
But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase.
"Act 2" is the global rollout.
Intel's third-quarter revenue increased by 21% year over year to $16.5 billion.
Gross profit jumped 36% year over year with a 44.1% non-GAAP margin, versus the margin of 40% reported in the prior-year quarter.
Intel's non-GAAP net earnings per share (EPS) were $0.52, up 126% year over year.
Importantly, the company's data center and AI segment posted $7.3 billion in revenue, up 78% year over year.
